subject: Ticketing and registration fee confusion – responsibility, communication gaps, and venue capacity
summary: This email thread captures a multi-day conversation surrounding ticketing policy changes, registration fees, and venue responsibilities. Ben Carter expresses confusion and concern over being unaware of a registration fee expected of artists, which was not documented in the venue manager agreement. Brighton Fringe box office staff alternately clarify and contradict each other over booking management, ticket transfers, and unticketed venue oversight. The conversation reflects breakdowns in communication, shifting of responsibility, and late-stage enforcement of unclear rules.
notes: Confirms Brighton Fringe failed to communicate new ticketing obligations and tried to retroactively enforce policy changes, causing disruption across multiple venues.
